create_memory_store: create a MemoryStore instance with bounded character limits for memory and user entries
add_memory_entry: add a new memory entry to the agent's personal notes or user profile store
replace_memory_entry: replace an existing memory entry by matching a short unique substring
remove_memory_entry: remove a memory entry from the store by matching a short unique substring
load_memory_from_disk: load memory and user entries from MEMORY.md and USER.md files on disk
